(excl. 2004, 2005, 2015, 2016)The Athletics cup is awarded to the school with the highest total score, according to the system explained above.The Pavilion/Spirit cup was awarded to the school with the best kreet (flashes) and overall spirit and discipline throughout the whole athletics day.This was known as the double era, where schools that won both titles achieved "double gold".
column26: From 2017 until further notice, there are 3 categories in the competition:The athletics cup, The spirit cup (best cheerleading throughout the athletics day) and the Pavilion cup (best flashes)This is known as the triple era, where a school can win all three categories (Triple Gold). This has not yet been achieved.
